To help your instructor form groups with similar preferences, please answer the following questions:

1. Of the three scenarios for project 3, which is your first choice? Which is your second? Please state the full scenario name to avoid confusion (e.g., Adaptalyst, Willowmere, Spoke City)

2. For communication, do you prefer to work in high contact groups ("I want to be in regular communication and share reminders, updates, etc.") or low contact groups ("Give me a task and trust me do it on my own by the deadline").

3. For work timeliness, do you prefer to finish tasks ahead of time or do you like to work right up until the final deadline? (No judgement here! There are plenty of successful people who prefer to work under pressure)

4. Do you care more about working on your first pick scenario or working with a group that shares your communication and work preferences?

Please make sure you clearly answer each of the four questions in your response. If your responses are unclear or you do not turn in this assignment, your instructor will choose a group for you.
